name: municipal-lending-digital-age
subject: Join a new generation of citizen investors
previewText: Be part of a thriving future for our places

fields.heading: A new generation of citizen investors
fields.body:
Municipal investments are loans to UK councils. You lend money to UK councils for a fixed period to fund real projects, and in return you earn a stable income for the investment term.

It used to be common for UK councils to borrow money from their residents, but it fell from popularity. Now we’re helping to bring it back, once again giving citizens an active role in the future of their local places.

fields.quote: “I’ve actually stood in places where the work has been done and thought: my money helped make this happen. That’s a really good feeling.”
fields.name: Citizen investor

fields.heading: Reinventing municipal investing for the digital age
fields.body:
Municipal bonds have been used as far back as the 1500s to finance local infrastructure across the country. They allowed councils to fund railway expansions, water supply systems and electric grids.

It is on these foundations that our own municipal investments are built. In this era of financial markets and opaque cryptocurrencies, we want to connect people with what their money is really doing.

fields.heading: Why it makes sense
fields.items:
Our municipal investments offer good value for councils and a competitive return for investors.
Your loan must be used for infrastructure projects and can’t be used to cover day-to-day costs.
It is a low risk investment. There is no record of a council ever defaulting on debt repayment.

fields.heading: Benefits at a glance
fields.intro: Municipal investments are designed for people looking for long-term investments with fixed cash interest payments.

cards.title: Regular interest payments
cards.body: Cash payments every 6 months to reinvest or withdraw.

cards.title: £5 minimum investment
cards.body: Everyone invests on the same terms.

cards.title: ISA eligible
cards.body: Invest through an Innovative Finance ISA.

cards.title: No fees
cards.body: The rates you see are the rates you get.
